verification_method: Browsed authoritative vendor/GitHub primary sources; resolved each tested GitHub release tag through the official API, then read LICENSE at its commit SHA. No app was launched, installed or tested.
scope: Original project license labels, exact version choice and additional terms; binary/hosted-service terms are separately scoped. A repository license is not a complete third-party binary notice audit.

Orca.evidence_scope: Release-tag repository LICENSE; tag package metadata version is 1.4.255. Standard MIT text; no project-specific exception in this file.

binary_and_service_terms.application_license: The official terms in effect on 12 November explicitly identify the application and source as MIT-licensed.
binary_and_service_terms.scope_note: The displayed November update is future-effective; it was not substituted for the terms still in effect. Bundled third-party notices retain their separate scope.

additional_terms: Copies or substantial portions must retain visible Dcouple attribution in the application UI.
Prior written permission is required to endorse derived products using the foozol name or Dcouple name/logo.
Pane.evidence_scope: The tested release LICENSE expressly permits version 3 or a later version and contains its own Additional Terms. The base SPDX identifier alone does not capture those terms; no SPDX exception identifier is invented.
Pane.metadata_note: Tagged package.json says AGPL-3.0, but the operative LICENSE is more specific: or-later plus additional terms.

binary_and_service_terms.scope_note: Vendor pricing explicitly discusses the desktop binary as open source under AGPL. Exact version choice and additional terms come from the pinned LICENSE. No separate release-specific binary EULA was established in this audit; bundled third-party software remains separately licensed.

Ghostex.evidence_scope: Release-tag root LICENSE contains the standard MIT grant, notice requirement and disclaimer, despite having no MIT title line. Tagged package metadata version is 11.5.0.

binary_and_service_terms.scope_note: MIT identifies original project software; embedded and vendored components have their own license files. No separate release-specific binary EULA was established from the tagged legal-file scan.
binary_and_service_terms.terms_file_note: The tagged TERMS.md is a project terminology glossary, not additional legal license terms.

T3 Code.evidence_scope: Root LICENSE is MIT at both comparison versions; both refs resolve to the same license blob. Release tags establish source scope, not a byte-for-byte audit of the downloaded desktop artifact.

binary_and_service_terms.scope_note: Terms mention desktop/mobile/hosted apps and optional Connect. Sections 4 and 15 preserve repository/component open-source rights and say those licenses control conflicts for that software; service access rights are separate. Bundled components retain separate notices.

OpenChamber.evidence_scope: Release-tag root LICENSE is standard MIT, and tagged root package.json independently declares MIT/version 2.7.0. No project-specific exception in the root grant.

binary_and_service_terms.scope_note: MIT is the original project code license. A tagged legal-file scan found component licenses, including embedded terminal/font notices, but no separate release-specific binary EULA. This is not an assertion that every byte of a desktop distribution has a single license.
